description: Per-column dataset-specific codec. 5 structured columns use fixed-width bit codes with arithmetic-free emitters (customer numbers, 2-bit genome, hex32, v1-UUID fields, coordinate digit fields with mini-Huffman). 18 text columns use Re-Pair phrase dictionaries + canonical Huffman token streams with inline numeric/timestamp payloads; zstd-compressed front-coded dictionaries; huffman-coded row bit-deltas for random access. Shared decoder serves bulk and row paths from identical archives.
name: dbtext-repair-huff-v1
